items.title: Agent identity startup Mintive lands Cowboy Ventures, Coatue, angels Jeff Dean, Andrej Karpathy
items.summary: Mintive was founded by two engineers who have been working on AI for decades through Google Brain, Coursera. It's platform promises to help IT easily control enterprise agents
items.creator: Julie Bort

items.title: Wabi, the AI agent that builds mini apps, now valued at $1.25B after latest round
items.summary: On Thursday, AI app, Wabi, now describing itself as a "personal agent," said it has raised $55 million at a $1.25 billion valuation.
items.creator: Sarah Perez
